# Exa Connector for Muse

A Muse agent skill for read-only neural web search over Exa's index: one call returns ranked sources, and each result's page text can be fetched so snippets carry substance. It never writes, modifies, or sends anything on your behalf. Uses an Exa API key (dashboard.exa.ai/api-keys), kept in Muse's secure vault. Free tier available. Draft: written from Exa's public API docs, not yet live-tested end-to-end — this listing's unverified status reflects that. No secrets in the repo.
